title: compact on-call minimap + conditional telemetry sampler for low-noise handoffs
author: Maya Gupta
release_notes: Adds a compact on-call minimap widget and an opt-in conditional telemetry sampler to reduce noise and speed handoffs. No breaking changes.
description:
Summary: Adds a compact on-call 'minimap' UI component for quick situational awareness during handoffs, and a conditional telemetry sampler that selectively captures higher-fidelity traces/metrics when the on-call context suggests meaningful deviation. Both pieces are opt-in and designed to reduce cognitive load and storage costs for long-running rotation transfers.

Motivation: During handoffs we repeatedly see pages where responders have to hunt through long alert lists and dense traces. The minimap surfaces a condensed timeline of recent alert clusters, top affected services, and outstanding runbook tasks. The conditional sampler aims to cut noise by only elevating telemetry sampling for sessions that show anomalous signal (error spikes, latency drift, or failing healthchecks) or when the minimap is actively inspected by a responder. This reduces the volume of full-fidelity traces and helps SREs focus on actionable incidents.

Design: - On-call minimap: a compact horizontal timeline widget rendered in the oncall hub (slo-toolkit UI). Shows last 6 hours by default, clustered events, colored by alert priority and service. Click-to-expand opens a contextual query view paired with a preloaded runbook snippet. Persisted per-rotation with ephemeral links for sharing. Implemented as a small React component (minimap/) with corresponding API endpoints to synthesize cluster metadata.
- Conditional telemetry sampler: server-side sampler implemented in the telemetry-proxy module. Default mode is conservative (sample 2% of traces). When the minimap is opened or when an anomaly detector flags a cluster, sampler temporarily activates higher sampling (up to 40%) for the matching service/trace families for a sliding 10-minute window. Sampling rules are stored as short-lived tokens in Redis and are automatically revoked. The sampler accepts white/blacklists per-customer and respects privacy flags (no PII capture).

Implementation notes and tradeoffs: - Sampling decisions are lightweight, evaluated at the ingress of telemetry-proxy; added ~0.4ms median overhead in local perf runs. - Minimap data is aggregated from existing event stores; synthetic cluster keys are computed with a small heuristic: time-window coalescing + service affinity + shared error signature. This is intentionally conservative to avoid false-positive sampling bursts. - Storage: increased short-term ingest (~15% during ramped sampling in e2e tests) but long-term storage decreased because fewer full-fidelity traces are kept for low-signal periods.

Checklist (PR-level): - [x] Minimap UI component and tests (unit + snapshot) - [x] Telemetry sampling logic and integration tests - [x] Redis short-lived tokens for sampling rules - [x] RBAC checks so only oncall roles can promote sampling from the UI - [x] Docs: operational guide and runbook snippets for minimap workflows - [x] Feature flag gating (slo.minimap.enabled, telemetry.conditional_sampler.enabled) - [x] e2e smoke with a synthetic alert storm

Commits (summary): - 3fd4b2b: scaffold minimap React component, styles, and unit tests - b1a9e88: add API endpoint /minimap/summary and clusterer logic - 9c2a0f7: telemetry-proxy: hook sampler hookpoints and token store - 5a7d9c1: add RBAC enforcement + feature flags and toggle checks - 2e4f33b: docs and runbook snippets + migration note for feature flags - 8f1cde4: perf tuning for sampler and added throttling logic

Files changed (high level): - src/minimap/ (React, CSS, tests) - server/minimap_handler.py (summary endpoint + clusterer) - server/telemetry_proxy.py (conditional sampling path) - infra/redis_tokens.py (short-lived token helpers) - docs/oncall/minimap.md (walkthrough + runbook templates) - docs/telemetry/conditional-sampler.md - tests/e2e/minimap_sampler_smoke.test.ts

Review conversation (highlights): - Evan Park (reviewer): "Nice ergonomic improvement. Two asks: 1) make the minimap keyboard accessible, 2) ensure sampling respects customer opt-outs."
  - Author reply: "Added keyboard focus states and aria labels in 3fd4b2b; sampler respects opt-out flags and there's an integration test SUP-8121 that covers this."
- Riley Chen: "Concerned about inadvertent sampling bursts during alert storms; suggest a global token rate limiter."
  - Author reply: "Added token-based throttling with exponential backoff and a global reservoir (8f1cde4). Saw <2% tail increase in stress tests."
- Sofia Martinez: "Docs look good. Can we add a short playbook snippet for handoff checks?"
  - Author reply: "Added a compact handoff checklist to docs/oncall/minimap.md and a copyable runbook seed."

CI and validation: - CI run 1: unit + lint: pass (flake8/tslint warnings fixed) - CI run 2: integration tests (minimap <-> telemetry): pass after adding mock token store - CI run 3: e2e smoke: pass with synthetic alert-storm generator - Perf: internal perf benching shows sampler adds 0.4ms median, p95 +1.6ms; acceptable for SLOs.

Rollout plan: - Behind feature flags by default off. - Canary to internal SRE rotations for 72 hours. - After canary: enable for 10% of accounts for 2 weeks with monitoring (ingest rate, sampled trace volume, feedback). - Full rollout contingent on no regressions in ingest cost and oncall satisfaction survey.

Merge details: Squash-merged by Evan Park after approvals from Riley and Sofia. Post-merge tasks: update internal runbook link in the oncall rotation template (done in follow-up PR), monitor telemetry ingest dashboard for sampling spikes.

Notes / follow-ups: - ENG-3348 to add ML-based cluster detection in a follow-up PR (marked experimental). - SUP-8121: added a customer opt-out test matrix and a remediation workflow for accidental sampling.

This PR focuses on operational ergonomics: faster handoffs, reduced noise, and cost-conscious elevated telemetry only when it meaningfully helps responders.
